applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it says the relevant witnesses were answered.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge treats the witnesses as answered rather than counting them as unanswered, K-G4's quote-and-name condition is not triggered.
